title: AI Clears the Backlog, Discipline Still Required
description: Steven talks about using AI workflows to turn 15 years of English-teaching material into months of scheduled content, along with gym routines, creatine, a broken elevator, and falling blueberry prices in Beijing. He also admits his coal stock call was wrong and says goodbye to Adam Curry as he leaves No Agenda.

sentences.zh: 内容速览
sentences.en: Quick Overview

sentences.zh: 周五这期节目内容丰富。
sentences.en: This Friday episode is packed with content.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文先聊了聊自己这一周沉迷AI工作流的经历，还有个计划：把15年的英语教学资料变成源源不断的内容。
sentences.en: Steven first talks about spending the week hooked on AI workflows, and about a plan to turn 15 years of English teaching materials into an endless stream of content.

sentences.zh: 接着他谈到健身、肌酸、换新的电梯，以及北京变便宜的蓝莓。
sentences.en: Next he talks about working out, creatine, the elevator being replaced, and blueberries getting cheaper in Beijing.

sentences.zh: 最后，他承认自己押错了煤炭，并向即将离开《No Agenda》的亚当·柯里道别。
sentences.en: Finally, he admits he bet wrong on coal, and says goodbye to Adam Curry, who is about to leave No Agenda.

sentences.zh: 被AI“偷走”的一周（心甘情愿）
sentences.en: A week "stolen" by AI (willingly)

sentences.zh: 史蒂文大约一周半前开始在终端里使用Claude。
sentences.en: Steven started using Claude in the terminal about a week and a half ago.

sentences.zh: 从那以后，他在电脑前待的时间“多得离谱”，却乐在其中。
sentences.en: Since then, he has spent a "ridiculous" amount of time at his computer, but he's enjoying it.

sentences.zh: 这周他最大的成果是一个“投放文件夹”：把视频文件丢进去，后面一连串自动化流程就会接手。
sentences.en: His biggest achievement this week is a "drop folder": drop a video file in, and a chain of automated processes takes over.

sentences.zh: 他称之为“太神奇了”。
sentences.en: He calls it "amazing."

sentences.zh: 不过它还没法完全自己跑，他常常得中途授权或纠正错误。
sentences.en: But it can't fully run on its own yet; he often has to authorize steps or fix errors along the way.

sentences.zh: 即便如此，他说：“看着电脑自己干活，真是太奇妙了。”
sentences.en: Even so, he says: "Watching the computer do the work by itself is truly amazing."

sentences.zh: 积压的英语教学内容
sentences.en: A backlog of English-teaching content

sentences.zh: 过去一年，史蒂文做了大量雅思和大学英语内容。
sentences.en: Over the past year, Steven made a large amount of IELTS and college English content.

sentences.zh: 做出来不难，难的是发布出去。
sentences.en: Making it wasn't hard; the hard part was getting it published.

sentences.zh: 他还想把英语教学和旅行内容分开，因为他的YouTube频道已经偏向旅行了。
sentences.en: He also wanted to separate his English-teaching content from his travel content, because his YouTube channel had already shifted toward travel.

sentences.zh: Claude估算，他手头的存货每天发的话够用六个月，隔天发则能撑八到九个月。
sentences.en: Claude estimated that his existing stockpile would last six months if he posted daily, or eight to nine months if he posted every other day.

sentences.zh: 他的反应是：“我之前为什么没早点这么做？”
sentences.en: His reaction was: "Why didn't I do this sooner?"

sentences.zh: 多年的瓶颈终于被解决了。
sentences.en: A bottleneck of many years was finally solved.

sentences.zh: 英语资料库与“超级文件夹”
sentences.en: An English resource library and a "super folder"

sentences.zh: 史蒂文一直设想有个独立的英语教学账号，能“实际上取代我和我的工作”。
sentences.en: Steven has long imagined a separate English-teaching account that could "actually replace me and my work."

sentences.zh: 去年他试过卖雅思课程和辅导，但没火起来。
sentences.en: Last year he tried selling IELTS courses and tutoring, but it never took off.

sentences.zh: 一边全职上班，一边做产品、搞营销，实在顾不过来。
sentences.en: Working full-time while also building products and doing marketing was simply too much to handle.

sentences.zh: 下一步是“超级英语文件夹”：把所有教学资料存进外接硬盘，交给AI整理并排期。
sentences.en: The next step is a "super English folder": store all his teaching materials on an external hard drive and let AI organize and schedule them.

sentences.zh: 他觉得这个估算偏保守：“如果我只有九个月的内容，那这15年我都干什么去了？”
sentences.en: He thinks this estimate is on the conservative side: "If I only have nine months of content, then what have I been doing for these 15 years?"

sentences.zh: 一篇不许用AI的作文
sentences.en: An essay written without AI

sentences.zh: AI也许会改变后期制作，但史蒂文说，学语言仍然需要时间、专注和自律。
sentences.en: AI may change post-production, but Steven says learning a language still takes time, focus and self-discipline.

sentences.zh: 课上，学生们手写了一篇作文，向“一个缺课的朋友”讲解两篇文章。
sentences.en: In class, the students wrote an essay by hand, explaining two articles to "a friend who missed class."

sentences.zh: 他们可以看笔记，但不能用AI，和考试一样。
sentences.en: They could look at their notes, but not use AI, just like in an exam.

sentences.zh: 写完后，他们拍照上传到DeepSeek或豆包。
sentences.en: After finishing, they took photos and uploaded them to DeepSeek or Doubao.

sentences.zh: 他自嘲成了“提示词猴子”。
sentences.en: He jokingly calls himself a "prompt monkey."

sentences.zh: 他的观点是：“学语言，你没有任何借口。”
sentences.en: His point is: "When it comes to learning a language, you have no excuses."

sentences.zh: 新的健身周期与肌酸
sentences.en: A new fitness cycle and creatine

sentences.zh: 史蒂文周三练完又跑了7公里，身体还很僵硬，所以没做大重量硬拉，而是做了轻重量、多次数的“负重拉伸”。
sentences.en: After his Wednesday workout, Steven ran another 7 kilometers, and his body was still very stiff, so instead of doing heavy deadlifts he did light-weight, high-rep "weighted stretches."

sentences.zh: 他相信这能强化关节：“大块肌肉其实不是问题，关节才是。”
sentences.en: He believes this strengthens the joints: "Big muscles actually aren't the problem; the joints are."

sentences.zh: 所谓“新周期”，主要是办了新的30天通行证。
sentences.en: The so-called "new cycle" mainly means he got a new 30-day pass.

sentences.zh: 上周六他开始吃一水肌酸，还把它和胶原蛋白混着喝。
sentences.en: Last Saturday he started taking creatine monohydrate, and he mixes it with collagen to drink.

sentences.zh: 他觉得力气大了点，不过也说，肌酸主要是让肌肉多吸水。
sentences.en: He feels a bit stronger, but he also says creatine mainly just makes muscles hold more water.

sentences.zh: “我没想练得特别壮。”
sentences.en: "I'm not trying to get super bulky."

sentences.zh: 录音棚里的小插曲
sentences.en: A Little Mishap in the Recording Studio

sentences.zh: 录到一半，Blackmagic Camera应用提示控制器与iPhone断开了，但录制没有中断。
sentences.en: Halfway through recording, the Blackmagic Camera app said the controller had disconnected from the iPhone, but the recording kept going.

sentences.zh: 他还给自己杂乱的设备拍了张“留作纪念”的照片：灯、麦克风和电线，都堆在他以前的厨房餐桌上。
sentences.en: He also took a photo of his messy setup "as a keepsake": lights, microphones and cables, all piled on the kitchen table at his old place.

sentences.zh: 一部电梯，爬不完的楼梯
sentences.en: One elevator, endless stairs

sentences.zh: 上个月史蒂文从加拿大回来，发现楼里两部电梯中的一部已停用更换。
sentences.en: Last month Steven came back from Canada and found that one of the two elevators in his building had been taken out of service to be replaced.

sentences.zh: 每部电梯大约要三个月，也就是说还要再用四个月左右的单电梯，差不多到春节。
sentences.en: Each elevator takes about three months, which means about four more months with just one elevator, almost until Chinese New Year.

sentences.zh: 他一直走楼梯上18楼，楼梯“又脏又臭”，因为外卖员有时把这里当厕所。
sentences.en: He has been taking the stairs up to the 18th floor, and the stairwell is "dirty and smelly," because delivery workers sometimes use it as a toilet.

sentences.zh: 他说：“更糟的我也经历过。”
sentences.en: He said, "I've been through worse."

sentences.zh: 不过也承认，爬到顶时已经气喘吁吁。
sentences.en: But he also admits that by the time he reaches the top, he's already out of breath.

sentences.zh: 北京菜价观察：蓝莓、牛奶和鸡蛋
sentences.en: Beijing grocery price watch: blueberries, milk and eggs

sentences.zh: 在April Gourmet，秘鲁蓝莓每125克从12.5元降到上周的8.9元，这周约7.2到7.5元。
sentences.en: At April Gourmet, Peruvian blueberries dropped from 12.5 yuan per 125 grams to 8.9 yuan last week, and this week they're about 7.2 to 7.5 yuan.

sentences.zh: 他猜是临近保质期的一批货，反正他在大量囤货。
sentences.en: He guesses it's a batch close to its expiration date; either way, he's stocking up big time.

sentences.zh: 他打趣说，也许吃蓝莓健脑没用，不然最近说话怎么老卡壳。
sentences.en: He joked that maybe eating blueberries doesn't help the brain, otherwise why does he keep getting tongue-tied lately.

sentences.zh: 牛奶：每升9.9元的澳洲牛奶好像下架了，现在多数要11到18元。
sentences.en: Milk: the 9.9-yuan-per-liter Australian milk seems to have been taken off the shelves; now most cost 11 to 18 yuan.

sentences.zh: 鸡蛋：一盒10个现在14.9元，之前是12.9元。
sentences.en: Eggs: a box of 10 is now 14.9 yuan; before it was 12.9 yuan.

sentences.zh: 他女朋友觉得那里太贵，都是叫外送。
sentences.en: His girlfriend thinks it's too expensive there, so she always orders delivery.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文则喜欢亲眼挑选食材。
sentences.en: Steven, on the other hand, likes to pick out ingredients with his own eyes.

sentences.zh: 糟糕：押错煤炭
sentences.en: Oops: Betting Wrong on Coal

sentences.zh: 史蒂文说他对煤炭“完全判断错了”。
sentences.en: Steven says he was "completely wrong" about coal.

sentences.zh: 他刚说煤炭超卖，道琼斯美国煤炭总指数就从约525点跌到500点以下，随后才略有回升。
sentences.en: Right after he said coal was oversold, the Dow Jones U.S. Coal Total Index fell from about 525 to below 500, and only recovered slightly afterward.

sentences.zh: 他还发现广汇能源可能更像一家液化天然气公司，而不是煤炭公司。
sentences.en: He also found that Guanghui Energy may be more of a liquefied natural gas company than a coal company.

sentences.zh: 谷歌表格现在抓不到中国股票的价格了，所以他用同花顺手动更新跟踪表。
sentences.en: Google Sheets can no longer fetch Chinese stock prices, so he uses Tonghuashun to update his tracking sheet by hand.

sentences.zh: 亚当·柯里告别《No Agenda》
sentences.en: Adam Curry says goodbye to No Agenda

sentences.zh: “播客教父”亚当·柯里将在10月29日之后离开《No Agenda》。
sentences.en: Adam Curry, the "Podfather," will leave No Agenda after October 29.

sentences.zh: 几个月前，他的搭档约翰·C·德沃夏克今夏去世。
sentences.en: A few months ago, this summer, his co-host John C. Dvorak passed away.

sentences.zh: 节目会由新主持人继续做下去，但史蒂文怀疑很难达到原来的水准。
sentences.en: The show will go on with new hosts, but Steven doubts it will reach its old standard.

sentences.zh: 今年62岁的柯里在周三的节目中宣布了这个决定，之后他将专注于为地方教会做播客。
sentences.en: Curry, 62, announced the decision on Wednesday's show. After he leaves, he will focus on making podcasts for local churches.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文觉得那档节目“耶稣味太重”，不合自己口味，不过他并不反对宗教。
sentences.en: Steven feels that show is "too heavy on Jesus" and not to his taste, but he isn't against religion.

sentences.zh: 最后，他表达了感谢：“看着亚当·柯里每周做三四五个播客，我就想，那我为什么不能？”
sentences.en: Finally, he expressed his thanks: "Watching Adam Curry make three, four, five podcasts a week, I thought, why can't I?"

sentences.zh: 他也为德沃夏克的离世表示哀悼。
sentences.en: He also expressed his condolences on Dvorak's passing.

sentences.zh: 今日总结
AI终于能帮史蒂文清掉积压15年的内容，但他说，学习、健身和做播客仍然离不开时间、自律和每天坚持。

segments.zh: AI终于能帮史蒂文清掉积压15年的内容，但他说，学习、健身和做播客仍然离不开时间、自律和每天坚持。

sentences.zh: 看着亚当·柯里的榜样，他不禁想：自己为什么不能多做一点？

segments.zh: 看着亚当·柯里的榜样，他不禁想：自己为什么不能多做一点？

vocab.en: the whole story, ins and outs
